svg.title: Nepal Data Pipeline — System Architecture
svg.desc: Architecture of the Nepal Data Pipeline: DataNepal Parquet source, optional ingestion, raw storage, pipeline.py orchestration (validate, parse dates, write cleaned Parquet, summaries, logging), processed outputs, separate quality scripts, separate PostgreSQL loading, Docker Compose, pytest and GitHub Actions.
svg.text: Ingest · validate · transform · store public Nepal observations (DataNepal Parquet) with Python, pandas, PyArrow and PostgreSQL
Summary CSVs are written to the
Separate commands — not executed by the default pipeline run
Inputs and outputs depend on the paths configured inside each
script; their individual data flow was not verified from source.
Separate workflow — run after the cleaned Parquet exists
The loader checks whether the observations table already contains records and refuses to load
if it does. Connection settings must match compose.yaml (database nepal_data, user pipeline_user).
depends_on db healthy · DB_* env from POSTGRES_PASSWORD (.env)
† Stage-to-module mapping inside src/pipeline.py was not verified from source. Diagram based on README.md, compose.yaml, Dockerfile and requirements.txt (as of 26 Oct 2026).
